user_query: Optimise the C-Town water distribution network using ctown.inp. Configure the baseline as a single-objective pump-energy minimisation with pump speed time series for ALL pumps, bounds 0.5 to 1.5, PDD required pressure 20 m, GA pop_size=5, and 5 generations. Then run a matched multi-objective comparison using pump_energy and modified_resilience_index, NSGA-II pop_size=5, 5 generations, and MRI Pstar=20 m. Seed=470568584. For this combined comparison experiment, produce the single-objective convergence plot and the two-objective Pareto solution distribution plot.
